title: Automated Plate Filling Protocol for 96-Well Plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the Automated Plate Filling protocol bundle from the Opentrons website.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If required, upload any custom labware definition files to the OT‑2 App before loading the protocol.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol bundle to the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.21.0 or later).

steps.title: Set up deck and load labware
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as follows: place a NEST 96‑well deep‑well plate in slot 11, load Opentrons 20 µL filter tip rack in slot 10, and position the desired number of HiMic 96‑well plates (400 µL) in slots 1‑9 according to the deck map.

steps.title: Load reagents into source wells
steps.instruction: In the deep‑well plate (slot 11), add Reagent 1 (Polymixin B 256) to well A1, Reagent 2 (Polymixin B 128) to well A2, and Reagent 3 (Growth Media Gamma) to well A3.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate the tip rack, the deep‑well source plate, each destination plate, and the p20 8‑channel pipette mounted on the right side.

steps.title: Add reagents to destination plates
steps.instruction: With the p20 8‑channel pipette, dispense 10 µL of each reagent as follows:

substeps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of Reagent 1 into columns 1‑6 of every destination plate.
Dispense 10 µL of Reagent 2 into columns 6‑12 of every destination plate.
Dispense 10 µL of Reagent 3 into all wells of every destination plate.

steps.title: Execute protocol on OT‑2
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App and monitor the robot as it completes the liquid‑handling steps.
